changes: Skip original box/keypoint heads only if original scores prove no candidate can pass.
Split exact INTER_AREA shrinking into two source strips at equivalent coefficient boundaries.

method.hardware: Intel Core i9-13980HX, Windows 11, CPUExecutionProvider. RTX 4060 unused by inference.

benchmark.micro_sampling: uniform across each whole video; sequential decode; interleaved videos
benchmark.inference: prepared CPU tensor to returned CPU outputs, including GPU transfers/synchronization
benchmark.capture_to_result: submission to result, including worker queue; excludes camera/driver
benchmark.scheduled_to_result: scheduled video PTS to result, including producer lateness
benchmark.excluded: preview/UI rendering, network, Re-ID, final image saving; models warm before replay
benchmark.startup: new model sessions in an existing Python process; OS file cache not flushed

method.runtime_held_constant: Both groups use HighQoS, ORT 4 threads, 1000 us spin/backoff 8, OpenCV 1 thread.
method.source_order: User then Wolfhound in A; Wolfhound then user in B. All inference jobs serial.
method.pooling: Concatenate all frame timings before percentiles; FPS=sum(processed)/sum(elapsed).
limitations: System load/frequency not locked; no worst-case latency guarantee.
Whole-video parity applies to these 2526 frames, not broad accuracy validation.
No preview/UI, network, ReID, camera-driver latency or final saving in process timers.
Diagnostic same-frame ablation and instrumented profiles are not real-time throughput.
No power/energy or mobile throughput measurements.
